title: Deliver Acarat consumer marketplace, persistent intent, and conversational discovery
outcome: Customers can discover, understand, compare, save, monitor, and act on Saudi properties through verified marketplace pages, map/list parity, lists, alerts, comparison, conversational search, and voice without hidden constraint relaxation.
rationale: Program-level child for the consumer experience spanning roadmap P05, P06, and consumer portions of P14. It is not executable until refined.
scope_in: P05 marketplace discovery and Property Passport
P06 lists, saved searches, alerts, notifications
P14 conversational and voice search consumer surfaces
acceptance: Consumer capabilities are decomposed into bounded Grains and preserve typed SearchIntent, deterministic execution, map/list parity, durable alerts, explainable results, Arabic/English parity, and privacy.

risk.recovery: Planning child only; implementation rollback is defined by refined Grains.
